publication: Artem Chernikov, Model Theory of Groups, Math 223M UCLA Spring 2018 lecture notes, last update May 21 2018; 25-page author-hosted PDF.

reviews.checked_passages: Printed p.8, Definition 2.25 and Proposition 2.26 only: strongly minimal theories and the elementary one-type count over a model.
reviews.consumers: Planning-only gap survey for model theory: possible generic-types and strong-minimal stability continuation.
reviews.outcome: The over-model argument has one realized equality type per model point and one generic type. The corpus can derive the more general parameter-set bound directly from finite/cofinite definability and formula counting; no ranks, forking, fields or group results are adopted or certified.
